institution.name: SMK – Statens Museum for Kunst (National Gallery of Denmark)

basis.en: Public domain: the artist died in 1948. SMK marks this image as public domain (Public Domain Mark 1.0).
basis.zh: 公有领域：作者卒于 1948 年。丹麦国家美术馆（SMK）将此图像标为公有领域（公有领域标记 1.0）。

alt.en: Two slender birches, every twig thick with white hoarfrost, lean over a snowy bank; behind them pale hills and a frozen valley disappear into bright, misty winter light.
alt.zh: 两棵纤细的白桦倚在积雪的坡上，每一根细枝都裹着厚厚的白霜；身后浅色的山丘和冰封的山谷，隐没在明亮而朦胧的冬日光线里。

note.en: Fjæstad was a Swedish painter so devoted to snow and frost that he became known as a master of hoarfrost, working with a circle of artists at Rackstad in Värmland. He painted frost not as a white blur but as a texture you can almost touch. The light is the brief, low sun of a northern winter day.
note.zh: 菲耶斯塔德是瑞典画家，痴迷于雪和霜，被称为“白霜大师”，他和一群艺术家在韦姆兰的拉克斯塔德一起工作。他画霜，不是一团白，而是一种几乎能摸到的质感。这里的光，是北方冬日里短暂、低斜的太阳。
